plan.summary: Uploads in `uploadAll` now run at most four at a time. The PR adds the `p-limit` dependency and wraps each `putObject` call in a limiter created with `pLimit(4)`. Before, `Promise.all` started every upload at once.
plan.riskRationale: Small change with a well-known dependency. The concurrency limit is hardcoded. The evidence shows no tests. The new dependency range `^6.1.0` is a modest supply-chain consideration.
plan.storyArc: The PR caps upload concurrency. It first adds the dependency, then applies it in `uploadAll`. The two parts form one behavior, so one topic covers them.

topics.title: Cap concurrent uploads at four with p-limit
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `uploadAll` now limit simultaneous uploads? Connect the new `p-limit` dependency and import to the `pLimit(4)` wrapper around each `putObject` call. Verify that the limiter is created per `uploadAll` call, so the limit of four applies per call and not globally.
